tools.name: check_document
tools.description: Start an originality check of ONE document for the user (PDF, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF or TXT, up to 10,000 words). Ask the user's permission first. Returns a token; the check takes 10 to 20 minutes. Send exactly one of content_base64 (with filename), text, or url. Open access has growing waiting times b

tools.name: get_check
tools.description: Get the status of a check started with check_document. While it runs, returns the estimated time left and poll_after_seconds; when done, a summary, a disclaimer to pass on, and a link to the full report (valid 24 hours).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_document · Private data: check_document · Public sink: check_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_document · Private data: check_document · Public sink: check_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
